# anthropic_analytics_connectors (Data Source)

Per-connector (MCP) usage for a Claude Enterprise organization, including read/write call classification and managed-auth adoption. Data is available from 2026-01-01 with about a one-day lag; the API allows 60 requests per minute per organization. Requires `analytics_api_key` (or an `enterprise_api_key` carrying `read:analytics`).

~> This is a point-in-time report that is re-read on every plan. Use it for outputs and policy checks, not to manage infrastructure.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Connector usage for one day, restricted to one RBAC group.
data "anthropic_analytics_connectors" "engineering" {
  date    = "2026-01-15"
  filters = ["rbac_group_id:rbac_group_01ExampleGroupId00000000"]
}

output "write_calls_by_connector" {
  value = { for r in data.anthropic_analytics_connectors.engineering.rows : r.connector_name => r.write_call_count }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `date` (String) Single UTC day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Exactly one of `date` or `starting_date` must be set.
- `ending_date` (String) Exclusive last day of the range, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Only valid with `starting_date`; defaults to today.
- `filters` (List of String) Filters as `dimension:value`; repeat a dimension for OR, mix dimensions for AND. Dimensions: `connector_name`, `product`, `rbac_group_id`, `user_id`.
- `group_by` (List of String) Dimensions to break rows out by: `product`, `rbac_group_id`, `user_id`.
- `limit_rows` (Number) Maximum number of rows to keep after reading every page. Unlimited when omitted.
- `order` (String) Sort direction, `asc` or `desc`.
- `order_by` (String) Sort field: the endpoint's name column or one of its rankable metrics.
- `starting_date` (String) First day of a range, `YYYY-MM-DD` (rollup mode: one row per entity over the range).

### Read-Only

- `rows` (Attributes List) One row per connector (times group dimensions). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rows))

<a id="nestedatt--rows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rows`

Read-Only:

- `chat_distinct_conversation_connector_used_count` (Number) Distinct chat conversations that used the connector.
- `claude_code_distinct_session_connector_used_count` (Number) Distinct Claude Code sessions that used the connector.
- `connector_display_name` (String) Resolved display name when `connector_name` is an opaque id.
- `connector_name` (String) Normalized connector name, or an opaque connector id.
- `cowork_distinct_session_connector_used_count` (Number) Distinct Cowork sessions that used the connector.
- `distinct_user_count` (Number) Distinct users who used the connector.
- `individual_auth_distinct_user_count` (Number) Distinct users on their own credential; null when not reported.
- `managed_auth_distinct_user_count` (Number) Distinct users on Enterprise Managed Auth; null when not reported.
- `office_excel_distinct_session_connector_used_count` (Number) Distinct Excel sessions that used the connector.
- `office_outlook_distinct_session_connector_used_count` (Number) Distinct Outlook sessions that used the connector.
- `office_powerpoint_distinct_session_connector_used_count` (Number) Distinct PowerPoint sessions that used the connector.
- `office_word_distinct_session_connector_used_count` (Number) Distinct Word sessions that used the connector.
- `product` (String) Product surface; present only when grouped by `product`.
- `rbac_group_id` (String) RBAC group id; present only when grouped by `rbac_group_id`.
- `rbac_group_name` (String) RBAC group name; null when the group was deleted or unresolved.
- `read_call_count` (Number) Tool calls annotated read-only; null when the split is unavailable.
- `unclassified_call_count` (Number) Tool calls without a trusted annotation; null when the split is unavailable.
- `user_id` (String) User id; present only when grouped by `user_id`.
- `write_call_count` (Number) Tool calls annotated as writes; null when the split is unavailable.
